sentences.jp: 「私は、あなたの子供を妊娠してるの。あなたに捨てられた時、もう妊娠してたのよ。知ってるでしょう。今、責任を取らないつもり」
sentences.ruby: 「私は、あなたの子供を妊娠[にんしん]してるの。あなたに捨[す]てられた時[とき]、もう妊娠[にんしん]してたのよ。知ってるでしょう。今、責任を取らないつもり」
sentences.en: "I'm pregnant with your child. I was already pregnant when you abandoned me, you know that, right? Now, you don't intend to take responsibility."

sentences.en: "That's great, Kinu-chan, you're now the foremost contributor to the Furukawa family. I'll make sure to cherish you from now on."

sentences.en: He informed Yuzuki that there would be a banquet at Cloud Town Villa No. 1 tomorrow, and since many big names would be attending, he suggested they go together to check it out while putting his arm around her shoulder.
